posts.title: Military Surplus M-14 rifles for sale
posts.description: Whoa : Announcement . By special authorization, the CMP is pleased to announce the future availability and sale of surplus M14 rifles. Prior to sale, the rifles will be modified to be permanently and irreversibly semi-automatic rifles.
